cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/bigcase.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref, gen
K = 64
c = list(range(1, K+1))
rib = []
rng = random.Random(9)
while len(rib) < 625:
    s = rng.randrange(K)
    rot = c[s:] + c[:s]
    rib.append({'path': list(rot), 'count': rng.randint(1, 1000000)})
agg = ref.aggregate([(tuple(r['path']), r['count']) for r in rib], set())
_l, _r, final = ref.peel_naive(agg)
cl = sorted({ref.canon(p[i], p[i+1]) for p in final for i in range(len(p)-1)})
order = gen.find_order(cl, final, random.Random(1), tries=100)
queries = []
for k in range(512):
    s = k % K
    rot = c[s:] + c[:s]
    queries.append({'id': 'q%d' % k, 'path': rot[:64], 'threshold': [k % 1000001, 1000000]})
doc = {'version': 1, 'ixps': [], 'rib': rib, 'priors': [], 'declared': [],
       'order': order, 'queries': queries}
json.dump(doc, open('/tmp/bigcase.json','w'))
print('written')
EOF
timeout 600 python3 /tmp/bigcase.py && cd /workspace && timeout 600 python3 -c "
import cProfile, pstats, sys, json, io
sys.argv=['x']
spec = __import__('importlib.util', fromlist=['util']).spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = __import__('importlib.util', fromlist=['util']).module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
doc = json.load(open('/tmp/bigcase.json'))
pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable()
res = m._process(doc)
pr.disable()
s = io.StringIO(); pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('cumulative').print_stats(12)
print(s.getvalue()[:2500])
